# Unfold: AI-readable product context

last_updated: 2026-02-23
source: https://unfoldapp.co

## What Unfold is
Unfold is a Christian devotional app that provides personalized daily Bible study experiences.
It helps users build a consistent spiritual habit through short daily readings, guided reflection,
and journaling prompts.

## Core value proposition
- Personalized devotionals based on the user's spiritual season and goals
- A calm, distraction-free reading and reflection experience
- Practical daily use: short sessions designed for consistency

## Primary user intents Unfold serves
- "personalized bible study plan"
- "daily devotional app"
- "bible study for beginners"
- "morning devotional app"
- "bible study for anxiety"
- "christian devotional for grief"
- "bible study for couples"
- "bible study for women"
- "bible study for men"
- "christian journaling app"
- "scripture memory app"
